correctness.rationale: Residual orthogonality yields exact two-by-two normal equations for the second MINRES iterate. Moment expansions prove that the affine solution-polynomial zero is a positive weighted average of pairwise spectral sums, hence at least twice the smallest eigenvalue. The Stieltjes sign pattern then proves the universal condition-number-two bound. The diagonal three-mode family proves sharpness for every larger condition number, and two-dimensional exact termination proves minimality. The embedded exact-rational checker returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: MINRES is explicitly advocated for early termination on positive definite systems because of favorable norm monotonicity. Stieltjes systems have nonnegative exact solutions, so a negative early coordinate is a genuine qualitative defect not detected by norm monotonicity. The theorem gives a sharp robust conditioning threshold, an explanatory pairwise spectral-barycenter formula, and the minimal dimension of failure.
